name: Doseology Sciences Inc.
summary: Doseology Sciences Inc. is a Canadian firm dedicated to the cultivation and extraction of ingredients for both nutraceutical and pharmaceutical applications. The company's primary focus lies in the research, development, and commercialization of medicinal mushroom products, offered in various forms such as tinctures and powders. Customers can acquire these items directly through its official e-commerce platform, doseology.com. Founded in 2019, Doseology Sciences Inc. is headquartered in Kelowna, Canada.
